notes.title: New update for Photo & Graphic Designer 15 Steam Edition!
notes.content:
[h1]Important changes in version 15.1.0.54112 compared to version 15.0.0.52648[/h1]



[i]Brand New Features[/i]
[list]
    [*] You can now place text inside all shapes, so that it flows within the shape’s outline. The new “Padding Margin” functionality helps to find the right space between the shape outline and the text.
    [*] Photo & Graphic Designer now includes Smart Tables. 15.1 supports table insertion and editing, including adding and removing rows/ columns, resizing rows & columns, various table formatting options and automatic formatting of the table to fit content.
    [*] Advanced Photo Grid functionality. The once “static” photo grids are now resizable through our new Smart Layout Framework.
[/list]
 

[i]Brand New Content[/i]
[list]
   [*] More than 45 new & interesting Smart Shapes: With the new layouts, shapes and text fields, you can create brilliant advertisements, modern flat designs and vivid informational graphics in no time at all.
   [*] 9 new Table Smart Shapes enabling you to easily create business tables and tailor them to your ideas thanks to flexible arrangement and scaling for lines and columns.
   [*] A variety of over 25 new Social Media Posts in the Online Content Catalog. Have a look at the following themes Company, Food Delivery, Security, Car Dealer, Logistics, Software Service and Fitness Trainer.
[/list]
